title: spec: `RecordChatterProps.position` declares a vocabulary no read point compares — `sidebar`/`inline`/`drawer` vs the renderer's `bottom`/`right`/`left` — and its `collapsible` default inverts the renderer's
body:
Found while implementing #8744 (measuring the `record:discussion` / `record:chatter` pair together, as its triage note required). Filed as an out-of-scope finding, unassigned — #8744 wires `record:discussion` to this same shared row on purpose (one renderer, one accept face), so whatever fix lands here repairs both names at once.

## The divergence, measured at the `.objectui-sha` pin (`665661ab0932`)

`ComponentPropsMap['record:chatter']` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `RecordChatterProps`) declares:

- `position: z.enum(['sidebar', 'inline', 'drawer']).default('sidebar')`
- `collapsible: z.boolean().default(true)`
- `defaultCollapsed: z.boolean().default(false)`

The renderer chain reads none of those position values. `RecordChatterPanel` (objectui `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordChatterPanel.tsx:87-96`) compares `config.position` against exactly `right` / `left` / `bottom`:

```
const position = config?.position ?? 'right';
const isSidebar = position === 'right' || position === 'left';
const isInline = position === 'bottom';
```

and the registration (`plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`, `CHATTER_INPUTS`) declares `enum: ['bottom', 'right', 'left'], defaultValue: 'bottom'` — agreeing with the panel, not with the spec row. `record-chatter.tsx` merges `{ position: 'bottom', collapsible: false, … , ...schema }`, so the renderer-side fallbacks are `bottom` / `false`.

Consequences today:

1. A spec-valid `position: 'sidebar'` (the schema's own **default**, materialized onto every parsed node that says nothing) matches neither branch and falls into the inline/bottom render — the declared value is a silent no-op, on the very surface whose row exists to make undeclared keys loud. The spec-invalid `position: 'right'` is what actually docks the panel.
2. The `collapsible` schema default (`true`) inverts the renderer merge's fallback (`false`): "the author said nothing" parses into "the author asked for collapsible", which is also not what the renderer would have done on its own.

## What a fix needs to decide

- Whether the row's vocabulary converges on the renderer's (`bottom`/`right`/`left`, a breaking value narrowing with an ADR-0087 conversion for the three old spellings), or the renderer learns the spec's — either way ONE vocabulary, not a mapping layer.
- Dropping the schema defaults per the `maxVisible` principle (#8691/#8744 precedent: renderer fallbacks stay the renderer's facts) — `.default('sidebar')` is itself half of defect 1.
- The row is shared by `record:chatter` AND `record:discussion` after #8744 — the fix must keep the pair on one schema object.

Blocked-by: nothing, but lands cleanly after #8744's PR (which touches the neighbouring map rows and pins the pair's shared identity).
